program.merge_policy: accumulate eight 25-finding passes; consolidate, run admission/runtime/repository gates, then merge once after 200

policy.validation_strategy: pass-first; cheap duplicate/entity screening during authoring; defer expensive repository-wide validation until 200-finding consolidation
